item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (69)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 69

  • Settings holds the scan choices: Fast or Thorough, processor, memory, and the accept cutoff.
  • Cull shows percent done and time left on separate lines. Stop ends the run. Cull again starts over.
  • Checking a folder includes its subfolders.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes
